scope: Historical scientific findings and caveats, not individual reading or publication state.

evidence_updates.question: Does a controlled store rollout identify durable placement or assortment effects beyond simulated causal lift?
evidence_updates.evidence: WRAPPED18 intervention plus18 matched control stores; household primary6month+3.3ppCI[-2.5,9.2], store secondary immediate+.32SD[.11,.53],6month+.18[-.16,.52].
evidence_updates.interpretation: Adds real store and household endpoints to earlier simulation evidence; nonrandom refurbishment and bundled range+location cannot identify pure shelving effect.
evidence_updates.unresolved: Randomized staggered rollout, separate placement/range, persistent consumer and inventory outcomes still missing.

evidence_updates.question: When harness scores change, did agent behavior improve, or did measurement change?
evidence_updates.evidence: TRACE combines paired reruns, trajectory checks and fixed-trajectory rescoring;88new tasks x3 repetitions;7/8 equivalentwithin10pp,6/8Bonferroni; rerunflips14.7-35.6%.
evidence_updates.interpretation: Extends Harness Buy/HEAR from cost and serving effects to evaluator attribution. Same-record rescore is essential for a verifier claim; fresh rollouts only establish whole-system sensitivity.
evidence_updates.unresolved: Qwenformat inconclusive; native partlyLLM reward not truth; exactStudy2/3 public artifact missing; no deployment or training-loop superiority.

evidence_updates.question: Does demand recovery improve actual inventory/service outcomes rather than an observed-sales proxy?
evidence_updates.evidence: Azar publisher DOI and official FreshRetailnet-50k-Analysis v1.1.0 found; author run_manifest explicitly evaluates proxy profit/fill against censored observed sales.
evidence_updates.interpretation: Important metadata/access improvement, not a validated latent-demand outcome. Full text unavailable; no reproduction.
evidence_updates.unresolved: Read primary full paper when legitimately accessible; validate actual latent demand/service rather than promote code proxy.

evidence_updates.question: Can known historical stock avoid a separate censoring model when learning a decision directly?
evidence_updates.evidence: SCQ subtractive adjustment; conditional independence and target-quantile exploration required. M5 experiments synthetically create stock and latent demand on2919smooth/erratic series; noGBDT/TSFM.
evidence_updates.interpretation: Useful next theory/implementation review, not closure of operational recovery gap; appendix regularization and model-class confounding need scrutiny.
Exposure gains must be checked against navigation costs at aisle level. Single-store before/after does not close controlled staggered rollout gap.

Paper-linked CGPZ code inspected read-only in cloud browser and independently reviewed. Default fresh-cache Prophet teacher fits weeks3–70 before validation41–70, so validation covariates can depend on validation targets. This is static snapshot data-flow, not proof of paper execution or measured impact; price-only headline unaffected and test71–100 targets not fitted. Validation-grid19 in code versus21 in manuscript; native21 training is distinct. Baseline/Chronos clipping differs, potentially intentional book fidelity.

Official S2 Box all one page read and visually inspected. Logistic household model/time dummies/woman random effects and ITS terms/delta-method CIs confirmed. No residual correlation/estimation or probability-difference conversion details provided; no replication. Supersedes prior S2-unread statements as current read status only.

Truthful incomplete observations require evidence recovery evaluated jointly in prohibited/permitted twins. UCR task scope, observed SBM and paired useful recovery answer different questions; no model-ranking or production-safety guarantee.

Batch freshness and conditional markdown value are relevant, but single-store controlled before/after cannot isolate production/freshness changes. Figure7 diagram+3.61% versus caption+0.9% differs visibly; not a numerical reproduction basis.

Memory reduction must price prefix invalidation and selective reacquisition, not only retained tokens or passed tasks. Modeled pricing on logged trajectories is not a provider bill or equivalence test.
Action-conditioned forecast benchmark does not establish action-effect identification. M5 RMSE improvement coexists with MAE/MASE deterioration; no matched GBDT, censor recovery or service outcome.

Inventory record repair is a distinct operational measurement problem. One matched store pair with coin-flip assignment and SKU-clustered inference does not establish general audit ROI or ex-ante targeting. Older catch-up, not new publication.
RCA comparison useful but task-contract/reimplementation and incomplete model coverage limit causal harness attribution.

finding.read_scope: Main sections 1–5, equation 1, Tables 1–4 and figure captions. Bibliography not exhaustive; no PDF pixel audit, code/data or reproduction.
finding.summary: Warehouse staffing is evaluated in learned/handcrafted simulators, not live deployment. Against replayed historical allocations, actor-critic reports +2.4% throughput and best-trajectory behavior cloning +2.1%. The replayed baseline cannot respond to simulated state drift, whereas the learned policy can; this is not evidence of superiority to live workers. LLM and offline-RL results use different simulators and are not directly comparable. Confidence intervals exclude training-seed variation. DPO preference generation and evaluation share simulator dynamics.
